SwapResponse.description: A provider that can route swaps.

shortName.description: Short code identifying the provider, e.g. `cl`. This is the value returned as `swap` on a quote, and the one to pass in `swaps`, `inLegIncludedSwaps` and the other provider filters.

txUrl.description: Prefix for viewing a transaction with this provider — append the transaction hash to it.

enabled.description: False when the provider is temporarily not routing swaps.

isDex.description: True for DEX providers, false for CEX providers.

deprecated.description: True when the provider is being retired and should not be relied on.

markupSupported.description: True when the provider can apply partner markup.

slippageSupported.description: True when the provider honours the `slippage` parameter.

autoSlippageSupported.description: True when the provider can choose slippage for you.

addressValidation.description: Regex a wallet address on this chain must match. Use it to validate `addressTo` before creating an exchange.

tokenAddressValidation.description: Regex a token contract address on this chain must match.

shortName.description: The chain's identifier. Pass this wherever an endpoint takes a chain, e.g. `ethereum`.

memoNeeded.description: True when a deposit on this chain needs a memo or destination tag, e.g. XRP or TON. Send it as `destinationTag` when creating the exchange.

hashUrl.description: Explorer link for a transaction hash, when it differs from `explorerUrl`.

explorerUrl.description: Template for a transaction link — substitute `{txHash}`, e.g. `https://blockchair.com/bitcoin/transaction/{txHash}`.

addressUrl.description: Template for an address link — substitute `{address}`, e.g. `https://blockchair.com/bitcoin/address/{address}`.

kind.description: Chain family, e.g. `evm`, `sol`, `bitcoin`, `xmr`, `ltc`. Determines the address format and which on-chain steps a DEX swap needs.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. `1` for Ethereum. Null on non-EVM chains.

enabled.description: False when the chain is temporarily not routing swaps.

shortNameV1.description: The chain's name in the v1 API. Use `shortName` instead.

TokenScanResult.description:
Security verdict for a token. Branch on this rather than on `features`.

- `Benign` — no issues found
- `Warning` — show a warning before swapping
- `Malicious` — do not swap
- `Unscanned` — could not be screened. Screening is fail-open, so this never blocks a swap on its own.

TokenScanFeature.description: One finding from the security scan, for display only. The list of possible findings changes over time, so branch on `resultType` instead.

type.description: Provider severity for this feature: Malicious | Warning | Benign | Info.

TokenScanUnscannedReason.description: Why a token ended up `UNSCANNED`. Diagnostic only — never a branching input.

provider.description: Screening provider that produced this verdict.

providerResultType.description: The provider's own `result_type` string, kept unmapped so a verdict we don't model yet is still visible to support instead of being erased.

maliciousScore.description: Provider `malicious_score`, 0..1. Arrives as a string; stored as a number.

expiresAt.description: When this verdict goes stale and the token should be re-scanned.

mainnet.description: True for the chain's native coin (e.g. ETH on Ethereum), false for an issued token (e.g. USDT). Not related to mainnet vs testnet.

hasBundler.description: True when the bundler can fund this token — paying for a whole multi-exchange group with one transaction instead of a deposit per order. Available on Solana, and on supported EVM chains.

hasSelfPrivate.description: True when the token supports self-to-self private swaps — send it and receive the same token at another address, with no on-chain link.

marketCapChange24h.description: 24h market cap change percentage from CoinGecko.

securityScan.description: Latest security verdict for this token. Absent until the token has been used in a swap at least once.

OrderStatus.description:
- **-2** Order is being initialized (label: INITIALIZING)
- **-1** Order initialized (label: NEW)
- **0** Waiting for deposit confirmation (label: WAITING)
- **1** Deposit is being confirmed (label: CONFIRMING)
- **2** Exchange is in progress (label: EXCHANGING)
- **3** Order is going through anonymization (label: ANONYMIZING)
- **4** Order completed successfully (label: FINISHED)
- **5** Order has expired (label: EXPIRED)
- **6** Order failed (label: FAILED)
- **7** Order was refunded (label: REFUNDED)
- **8** Order was deleted (label: DELETED)

Status.description:
- **0** New swap
- **1** Waiting for confirmation
- **2** Being confirmed
- **3** Exchange in progress
- **4** Sending to destination
- **5** Swap completed
- **6** Swap failed
- **7** Swap refunded
- **8** Verifying swap
- **9** Swap expired
- **10** Fallback mode

depositTag.description: Memo/tag required when depositing funds for assets that use one

inAmountUsd.description: USD value of the input amount at order creation time.

rerouted.description: True when the route that executed is not the one that was quoted, because the quoted route failed and a fallback was used. The amounts may differ from the quote — compare `inAmount` against `quotedInAmount` and `outAmount` against `quotedOutAmount`.

quotedInAmount.description: The deposit amount originally quoted, present only when the order was rerouted. `inAmount` is what the fallback route actually asks for; on an exact-out order this is the side that moves.

quotedOutAmount.description: The payout originally quoted, present only when the order was rerouted. `outAmount` is what the fallback route will actually pay; on an exact-in order this is the side that moves.

restrictedCountries.description: ISO country codes where this route may not be offered.

rewardsAvailable.description: True when the swap earns rewards.

max.description: Largest amount this route accepts, e.g. `5` BTC.

minOut.description: Smallest amount you can receive, e.g. `100` USDT. Present only when `amountType` is `receive` and the provider returns receive-side bounds.

maxOut.description: Largest amount you can receive, e.g. `50000` USDT. Present only when `amountType` is `receive` and the provider returns receive-side bounds.

rateId.description: Identifies the locked rate on a fixed-rate quote. You do not pass this when creating the exchange — `quoteId` carries it.

fixed.description: True when the rate is locked until `validUntil`.

requiresApproval.description: True when the wallet must approve the token before swapping — EVM and Tron non-native tokens. Use the allowance and approve endpoints.

depositAddressSupported.description: True when the route can be funded by sending to a deposit address, with no connected wallet.

appliedApiMarkup.description: The per-request markup this quote was priced with, as a percentage (`0.5` = 0.5%), echoing the `markup` you sent. Absent when your stored account markup applied. On a private swap this is the PER-LEG value and is charged on both legs.

refundAddress.description: The refund address this quote was priced with, echoing what you sent.

amountType.description: Whether the amounts are driven by the send side (`send`) or the receive side (`receive`).

amount.description: Amount of the `from` token to swap, e.g. `1.5` BTC or `250.75` USDT — not base units / wei like `100000000000000`.

from.description: Token you are swapping from. Use an `id` from GET /v2/tokens — a 24-character hex id such as `6689b73ec90e45f3b3e51564`, not a symbol like `BTC`.

to.description: Token you are swapping to. Use an `id` from GET /v2/tokens — a 24-character hex id such as `6689b73ec90e45f3b3e51558`, not a symbol like `ETH`.

markup.description:
Markup for this request, as a percentage — `0.5` means 0.5%.

- send `0` for no markup, or omit the field to use your account default
- providers that cannot apply it are excluded from the results

useXmr.description: Use XMR if true, if false use another token for the anonymous transaction

fixed.description: Request a fixed-rate quote. Only partners that support fixed rate will be returned. Available for standard and private CEX quotes; not supported for DEX.

refundAddress.description:
Where funds are returned if a swap cannot complete. Optional here — quotes are never filtered by it.

- a route that will need one comes back with `requiresRefundAddress: true`
- supply it at `POST /exchanges`, where it is required for fixed-rate quotes and for those routes

deviationThreshold.description: Maximum price deviation percentage when rotating wallets. Only used if rotatePayoutWallets is true. Default 5

rotationLookback.description: Number of recent orders to check for path rotation. Only used if rotatePayoutWallets is true. Default 10

rotatePayoutWallets.description: Rotate the payout path for better privacy. Only used for private swaps (`types=private`) — standard and DEX are single-leg and ignore it.

rotateFallback.description: When strict rotation exhausts every rotated route, fall back to a valid non-rotated route instead of failing. Default false. Requires rotatePayoutWallets — a no-op on its own.

types.description: Types of quotes to return; if omitted, all types are used

swaps.description:

- applies to every quote type — private, standard and DEX

inLegIncludedSwaps.description: Only use these providers for the in-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes, which are single-hop.

inLegExcludedSwaps.description: Never use these providers for the in-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Does not affect the out-leg. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes.

outLegIncludedSwaps.description: Only use these providers for the out-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes, which are single-hop.

outLegExcludedSwaps.description: Never use these providers for the out-leg of a private (2-hop) route. Does not affect the in-leg. Ignored by standard and DEX quotes.

receiverAddress.description:

amountType.description:
Whether `amount` refers to the send side or the receive side.
- `"send"` (default): amount is what the user sends — system computes what they receive.
- `"receive"`: amount is what the user wants to receive — system computes what they must send. Requires `fixed=true`. Available for standard and private CEX quotes; DEX quotes are dropped from the result, and a DEX-only request is rejected.

MultiQuoteMode.description:
Controls how many of the submitted orders are individually quoted.
- `all` (default): every order is quoted and returns its own array of candidate routes.
- `single`: only the first order is quoted; the remaining orders come back with `quoted: false` and no candidates — a lighter, faster preview for when quoting the whole batch is too slow.

get.description:
Returns the list of available tokens. Use the returned `id` as the `from` / `to` of a quote.

Without filters this returns every enabled token, 1000 per page and several MB per response. Narrow it with:

- `term` — search by name, symbol, address or cexTokenId
- `hasCex` — tokens available for private and standard swaps
- `hasDex` — tokens available for DEX swaps
- `hasBundler` — tokens the bundler can fund in one transaction
- `chain` — one chain only, e.g. `ethereum`. Use a `shortName` from [Get chains](/api-reference/reference-data/get-chains)

Tokens we have not reviewed are excluded unless you pass `unverified=true`.

tags.name: Private and Standard Swaps
tags.description:
CEX swaps in two modes, sharing the same endpoints — pick one with the `types` parameter.

- `types=standard` — direct single-leg swap. Fastest, no privacy hop.
- `types=private` — two legs through a privacy bridge (XMR by default), so deposit and payout are not linkable on-chain. Adds `anonymous`, `useXmr`, `rotatePayoutWallets` and the `inLeg*` / `outLeg*` filters.

Flow: `GET /tokens?hasCex=true` → quote → `POST /exchanges` → `GET /orders`. `markup` works in both modes.

tags.name: DEX Swaps
tags.description:
On-chain swaps signed and funded from the user's own wallet.

Flow: `GET /tokens?hasDex=true` → quote with `types=dex` → check allowance → approve → sign chain signatures → `POST /exchanges` → confirm the transaction.

- `slippage` applies to DEX only
- `markup` is not supported

tags.name: Multi-Exchange
tags.description:
Create and track a group of swaps sharing one `multiId`.

- routes are chosen for you — no `quoteId` needed
- each order gets its own deposit address; poll `GET /exchanges/multi/{multiId}` for every leg
- CEX standard and private only — no DEX in a batch

To fund the whole group in one transaction, see Bundler SOL or Bundler EVM.

tags.name: Bundler SOL
tags.description:
Fund a whole multi-exchange group with one Solana batch transfer.

- up to 10 deposits per batch; all orders share one source chain
- find batchable tokens with `GET /tokens?hasBundler=true`
- build the transaction, then sign and broadcast it from the wallet
- nothing to submit back afterwards — retry and recovery are EVM-only

tags.name: Bundler EVM
tags.description:
Fund a whole multi-exchange group with one ERC-4337 UserOperation, submitted through the bundler.

- up to 20 legs per batch; all orders share one source chain
- find batchable tokens with `GET /tokens?hasBundler=true`
- build the UserOp, then submit the signed result
- if a bundle fails: retry within 30 minutes, or recover stuck assets

tags.name: Reference Data
tags.description: Optional lookups: supported chains, liquidity providers, and per-pair min/max swap amounts. Responses are cached and change rarely — safe to fetch once and reuse. Token ids come from `/tokens`, listed in each swap section above.

tags.name: Partner Account
tags.description: Your partner profile, earned commissions, withdrawals, volume analytics, and the rate-limit budget attached to your API key. Every endpoint is scoped to the partner that owns the key making the request.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Service health. `GET /status` is unauthenticated and exempt from x402 payment — use it for uptime monitoring.
